name: Dumbbell overhead triceps extension

phases.name: squeeze
phases.cue: Squeeze your triceps at the top

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower the dumbbell behind your head

phases.name: reset
phases.cue: Elbows up, pointing at the ceiling

formTips: Hold one dumbbell upright with both hands, palms up under the top plate
Keep your elbows pointing up, close beside your head
Only your forearms move: lower the dumbbell behind your neck, then straighten your arms
Brace your core and keep your ribs down
Lower slowly and stop when your forearms touch your biceps
commonMistakes: Letting the elbows flare out wide
Arching the lower back to push the weight up
Moving the upper arms instead of just the forearms
Dropping the dumbbell fast behind the head
